scenarios.name: Open client registration page via Join Healing Sky
scenarios.criteria: After clicking 'Join Healing Sky' and selecting 'Join as a Client', the client registration page is displayed.

scenarios.name: Fill fields on client registration form except phone number
scenarios.criteria: The 'fullName', 'email', 'Address Lookup', and 'referral_code' fields are filled with valid values. The Date of Birth dropdowns are set correctly. A check confirms the values remain filled. The form is ready for phone number entry.
scenarios.endState: Client registration form is populated, excluding the phone number field.

scenarios.name: Enter phone number and submit client registration
scenarios.criteria: The 'phoneNumber' field is filled with a valid formatted number. On submission, registration is successful if a success message appears or the application navigates to the client login page.
preconditions: All other fields on the client registration form are filled except the phone number.
scenarios.startState: Client registration form is populated, excluding the phone number field.
scenarios.endState: Registration is successfully completed or client login page is displayed.

scenarios.name: Navigate to client sign-in and log in using configured email
scenarios.criteria: Navigating to the client sign-in page, using Email as OTP delivery, and logging in with the configured test email opens the OTP verification page.
scenarios.endState: Client OTP verification interface is displayed.

scenarios.name: Verify OTP and access client dashboard
scenarios.criteria: Entering the configured OTP bypass value into the OTP fields and clicking Verify displays the success message 'OTP verified successfully' and the authenticated client dashboard.
preconditions: Client OTP verification interface is displayed.
scenarios.startState: Client OTP verification interface is displayed.

scenarios.name: Client logs out and is returned to the homepage
scenarios.criteria: After logging out via the account dropdown, and confirming any logout dialog, the client is signed out and redirected to Healing Sky homepage, with the Log in option visible.
scenarios.endState: Healing Sky homepage is displayed with the Log in option visible.
